name: verify-gate
description: Asks before git commit or gh pr create while edited code has not passed a check command since its last edit.

watch.title: Watched paths
watch.description: Regex on the edited file path. A match marks the session unverified.

check.title: Check commands
check.description: Regex on a Bash command. When a match exits 0, the session is verified.

ship.title: Ship commands
ship.description: Regex on a Bash command. A match asks first while the session is unverified.
